name: Jared (son of Mahalalel)
title: The longest-lived patriarch
summary: Jared was the sixth generation from Adam through the line of Seth and the father of Enoch. He is best known for having lived longer than any other person mentioned in the Bible, with a lifespan of 962 years. His name means 'descent' or 'the one who comes down'.

keyEvents.title: The birth of Jared
keyEvents.description: Jared was born when his father Mahalalel was 65 years old, as part of the godly line of Seth.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Enoch
keyEvents.description: When Jared was 162 years old, he had a son named Enoch, who later became known for walking with God.

keyEvents.title: A Long Life with Many Children
keyEvents.description: After Enoch's birth, Jared lived another 800 years and had more sons and daughters.

keyEvents.title: The Death of Jared
keyEvents.description: Jared lived to be 962 years old, the longest lifespan recorded in the Bible, and then he died.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jesus' Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jared is included in Luke's genealogy showing Jesus' ancestry back to Adam.
